48:24.text: And it is He who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them within
Makkah after He caused you to overcome them. And ever is Allāh, of what you do, Seeing.

48:25.text: They are the ones who disbelieved and obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Ḥarām while the offering
was prevented from reaching its place of sacrifice. And if not for believing men and believing women whom you did not know - that you might trample
them and there would befall you because of them dishonor without
[you would have been permitted to enter Makkah]
that Allāh might admit to His mercy whom He willed. If they had been apart
, We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with painful punishment

48:26.text: When those who disbelieved had put into their hearts chauvinism - the chauvinism of the time of ignorance. But Allāh sent down His tranquility upon His Messenger and upon the believers and imposed upon them the word of righteousness, and they were more deserving of it and worthy of it. And ever is Allāh, of all things, Knowing.

48:27.text: Certainly has Allāh showed to His Messenger the vision
in truth. You will surely enter al-Masjid al-Ḥarām, if Allāh wills, in safety, with your heads shaved and
. He knew what you did not know and has arranged before that a conquest near

48:28.text: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is Allāh as Witness.
